translations.web: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
translations.bsb: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
translations.kjv: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
translations.asv: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.
